heading: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: USCIS warns applicants about businesses falsely promising faster visa and Green Card processing. These entities claim special government connections and demand fees for expedited services. Applicants should use official .gov resources and report suspicious offers to avoid unauthorized providers. The Department of Justice offers lists of low-cost or free legal immigration services. USCIS also provides tips for accurately completing and submitting application forms online.
